result.topic_en: A methodological reflection comparing mathematics with chess and physics: unlike them, mathematics sets its own problems, so it risks fragmentation and needs guiding viewpoints and the relating of each result to the whole science.

items.english: From this it follows: working through the existing material is better than each person digging further in his own muck, which nobody cares about anyway.
